title: INSTALLATION GUIDE
officialText:
TIP 1: SELECTION OF INSTALLATION LOCATION
Indoor Unit
-Air circulation: It should be installed at a position where the air can circulate throughout the room, avoiding the air outlet directly facing areas such as beds and sofas where people stay for a long time.
-Distance from the ceiling: At least 8 inches (0.67 feet) from the ceiling to ensure smooth return air.
-Ground height: Usually installed at a high place, but it is necessary to ensure that it can be reached during maintenance and cleaning.
-Horizontal installation: A level must be used to ensure absolute levelness; otherwise, it will cause poor drainage of condensate water, leading to leakage.
-Stay away from heat sources and steam: Keep away from heat sources such as lamps and stoves.
Outdoor Unit
-Stability and load-bearing capacity: It must be installed on a solid load-bearing wall or a reinforced platform. Concrete walls and solid brick walls are ideal choices.
-Good ventilation: Leave sufficient space in front, back, left and right (usually more than 0.5 ft from the wall at the back, more than 1 ft from the left and right sides, and more than 6.5 ft from the front air outlet) to ensure heat dissipation effect. Poor heat dissipation can lead to a sharp decline in efficiency and an increase in power consumption.
-Avoid direct sunlight and rain (as appropriate) : If conditions permit, a sunshade can be installed to prevent direct sunlight, but it must not affect ventilation.
-Noise consideration: The outdoor unit generates noise during operation. It is advisable to avoid having its air outlet directly facing a neighbor's window or rest area.
-Easy to maintain: The installation location should enable maintenance personnel to carry out maintenance safely and conveniently.
TIP 2: ULTRA-LONG CONNECTION LINES
For optimal performance, please verify that your planned installation location is within the reach of the fixed-length pipelines. We recommend checking the length data prior to ensure a smooth installation.
9,000 BTU Unit Pipelines: 13.1ft Suction Line, 13.1ft Liquid Line, 14.8ft Signal Cable (16AWG, 4 cores), 11.5ft Power Cord (14AWG, 3 cores), 6.6ft Drain Hose
12,000 BTU Unit Pipelines: 16.4ft Suction Line, 16.4ft Liquid Line, 18ft Signal Cable (16AWG, 4 cores), 11.5ft Power Cord (14AWG, 3 cores), 2 * 6.6ft Drain Hoses (2 * 4.9 ft Drain Hoses for Enduring 12,000 BTU model)
18,000 BTU Unit Pipelines: 16.4ft Suction Line, 16.4ft Liquid Line, 18ft Signal Cable (16AWG, 4 cores), 11.5ft Power Cord (14AWG, 3 cores), 2 * 6.6ft Drain Hoses
24,000 BTU Unit Pipelines: 16.4ft Suction Line, 16.4ft Liquid Line, 18ft Signal Cable (16AWG, 4 cores), 11.5ft Power Cord (14AWG, 3 cores), 2 * 6.6ft Drain Hoses
Exception: E-Save Series do not include the power cord.
